goal: Allow users and external tools to manually manage prune locks via RPC and startup options
Protect blocks needed by unloaded wallets and external indexers from being pruned
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Support because it prevents needing resyncs when external wallets or indexers fall behind (achow101, stickies-v)
Verified by testing with electrs and running functional tests on pruned signet (optout21, GEREMIAA)
Minor open suggestions on RPC help text, lock ID naming consistency, and reorg handling (GEREMIAA, optout21)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it adds RPC endpoints to manage prune locks without requiring full node re-syncs
Directly benefits downstream tools like indexers and external wallets operating on pruned nodes
